content.text: RUTH’S CHRIS STEAK HOUSEMYRTLE BEACH ***EXTENDED HOURS FOR EASTER, SUNDAY, APRIL 5th*** open starting at 11:30 am | reservations recommended Welcome toRuth's Chris Myrtle Beach 8211 Marina Pkwy at Grand Dunes Blvd Myrtle Beach, SC 29572 Hours Wednesday4:00 PM – 10:00 PMHappy Hour Dinner4:00 PM – 6:30 PM 4:00 PM – 10:00 PM Amenities DeliveryThis location offers delivery to your doorstep. Private DiningLarge party seating is available at this location. Welcome to Ruth’s Chris in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, where our dedicated team is committed to crafting for you an extraordinary dining experience unlike anything else. Our steak house is conveniently located next to the Marina Inn At Grande Dunes Hotel overlooking the Intracoastal Waterway and Grande Dunes Marina across the street from Pirates Voyage, formerly Dixie Stampede. Other nearby attractions to our steak house include: Myrtle Beach Pelicans, Myrtle Beach Oceanfront Boardwalk, Broadway at the Beach, and more. Whether you’re celebrating a special milestone, entertaining clients, or simply enjoying a night out with friends and family. Polite Notice At Ruth’s Chris we promote a comfortable, family-friendly, and welcoming atmosphere for everyone. We ask Guests to support this atmosphere by not wearing workout gear, pool attire, cut-off shorts, tank tops, clothing with offensive graphics or language, revealing clothing or exposed undergarments. We kindly ask all Guests to remove hats when entering. Hats and team support jerseys are welcome in our bar and lounge areas. Specific requirements may vary by location.
